quotes.text: 513. ¿CUÁNTAS HORAS TRABAJÓ LA SEMANA PASADA, EN SU OCUPACIÓN PRINCIPAL, EL DÍA…
518. ¿CUÁNTAS HORAS TRABAJÓ LA SEMANA PASADA EN SU(S) OCUPACIÓN(ES) SECUNDARIA(S)?
Sólo realizó quehaceres del hogar? ............................................ 8 Pase a pgta. 212

assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire records hours worked in the main occupation (Question 513) and secondary occupation (Question 518). For household chores in Chapter 200 (Question 211A), selecting code 8 ('Sólo realizó quehaceres del hogar') skips the hours question entirely ('Pase a pgta. 212'). The instrument contains no time-use questions recording time allocation across daily activities such as unpaid care/domestic work, leisure, or self-care. Per the defined evaluation rule for this indicator, if the instrument only records hours of paid work with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false.
